categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Guibao Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new materials industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of high-end organosilicon sealants, hot melt adhesives, silane coupling agents, and silicon-carbon anode materials. The company serves multiple sectors including construction, automotive manufacturing, new energy, energy conservation, environmental protection, and next-generation information technology. It has expanded its product portfolio through acquisitions and internal development to cover a broad range of adhesive and sealing materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in organosilicon sealants, polyurethane sealants, silane-modified polyethers, hot melt adhesives, epoxy adhesives, and acrylic adhesives. It maintains a strong R&D team with over 263 researchers, including PhDs and masters, and holds 458 patents globally. Production employs advanced automated and intelligent manufacturing lines, with a focus on digital transformation and smart factory initiatives. The company also develops specialized materials for lithium-ion batteries, including silicon-carbon anode materials, and has established national-level innovation platforms and testing centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span the construction industry (building curtain walls, energy-efficient doors and windows, prefabricated buildings), automotive manufacturers (including major domestic and international OEMs and suppliers), photovoltaic and new energy sectors, electronics and electrical appliances, power industry, and consumer goods sectors. The company serves over 5,000 industrial clients and exports products to more than 60 countries, including India, Brazil, South Korea, Indonesia, the US, and Russia. Major clients include BYD, CATL, ZTE, DJI, and leading photovoltaic companies like LONGi and Tongwei.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Sichuan (Chengdu, Meishan), Jiangsu (Nantong), Anhui (Ma'anshan), Shanghai, and other regions. It is expanding its presence in the Yangtze River Delta by establishing a new R&D and production center in Shanghai. Internationally, it exports to Asia, Europe, and South America, maintaining stable sales channels in over 60 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Guibao operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical materials supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of high-end adhesive and sealing materials. It sources raw materials such as organosilicon polymers and petroleum-based polymers from upstream suppliers and provides value-added products to downstream industries including construction, automotive, electronics, and new energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with continuous R&D investment exceeding 100 million RMB annually. Strategic R&D focuses include high-performance organosilicon sealants, environmentally friendly adhesives, silicon-carbon anode materials for lithium-ion batteries, and advanced materials for photovoltaic and automotive applications. It emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and expanding its innovation platforms across multiple locations. The company also pursues external collaborations with universities and research institutes to enhance its technology pipeline.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including organosilicon sealants, hot melt adhesives, silane coupling agents, and silicon-carbon anode materials. Sales channels include direct sales, distribution networks, and e-commerce platforms. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management. Its revenue is largely product sales-based, with a focus on volume growth and market share expansion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Guibao is a leading domestic player and recognized as the industry leader in China's organosilicon sealant market. It holds a dominant market share and is among the top global organosilicon enterprises. The company competes with both domestic and international adhesive manufacturers, including foreign giants in the hot melt adhesive sector. Its competitive advantages stem from strong technology, brand recognition, scale, and comprehensive product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately 3.16 billion RMB, a 21.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 237.5 million RMB, reflecting a 24.63% decrease due to raw material price declines and intensified market competition. The company has steadily increased production capacity to 370,000 tons annually and expanded its workforce to nearly 1,900 employees. It has maintained a compound annual growth rate of over 20% in revenue and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu Guibao emphasizes high-quality, high-performance, and technologically advanced adhesive materials that meet stringent international standards and certifications. Its products offer superior durability, environmental friendliness, and specialized functionalities such as high thermal resistance, flame retardancy, and electrical insulation. The company differentiates itself through strong innovation capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, integrated solutions combining materials and equipment, and a robust global brand recognized for reliability and technical excellence.
